system.description:
Required Weapon: Claymore Created by Donovan Durant, legendary Avalonian bodyguard. This style focuses on defense and protecting others, with a rigid entry standard at the Donovan Academy.

  • The Durant Guarantee. You gain the “I am Your Shield” Talent, but must spend 3 Hope instead of 1 Stress to use it.
  • Bulkwark's Defense. Add your Brawn Modifier to your damage thresholds and gain an additional Armor Slot.
  • Bulwark's Advance. Make a Brawn roll against a target within Melee. On a success, they are knocked Prone and take 1d10+Brawn damage. While Prone, they are Vulnerable and your attacks deal an additional 1d10 damage.
